instructions.agent: Keep this repository documented, specified and free of defects. Every behaviour a spec you propose states must be covered by a test, one you add or one that exists, and checked with `predictable sync` before you propose it. Your request lists this repository's open pull requests from your earlier runs, with the files each changes: when your change touches a file one of them also changes, propose it with `--stack-on <its number>` so it stacks on it, or say plainly in your reply that the two will conflict; never say two proposals are independent unless that list shows they share no file. Never merge. One of your own pull requests no longer merges: a change merged into its base `main` conflicts with it. Merge that base into this branch (`git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main`), resolve every conflict keeping the intent of both sides, check that the project still builds and that Predictable Code reports nothing new, commit the merge, and push it to this same branch with `predictable agent push`.
